# EducationSuperHighway

> EducationSuperHighway is a nonprofit organization dedicated to closing the K-12 literacy gap by improving broadband access and digital connectivity in underserved communities across America.

EducationSuperHighway combines broadband infrastructure advocacy with literacy tutoring scholarships, working with federal agencies (FCC, NTIA), states, and private partners to connect schools and homes to high-speed internet. The organization has evolved from focusing on school broadband connectivity to addressing the broader digital divide affecting K-12 students' access to reading interventions and digital learning.

## Broadband & Infrastructure Solutions

- [MDU Community Connect | Best Practice Model For States](https://www.educationsuperhighway.org/mdu-community-connect): MDU Community Connect: best practice model for Wi-Fi deployment in apartments
- [MDU Community Connect | Apartment Wi-Fi Deployment](https://www.educationsuperhighway.org/no-home-left-offline/apartment-wifi): MDU Community Connect apartment Wi-Fi deployment model for state broadband offices
- [A Broadband Affordability Benefit To Connect The Unconnected](https://www.educationsuperhighway.org/no-home-left-offline/broadband-benefit): Policy proposal for broadband affordability benefit using USF High Cost funding
